prompt:
寫一個 Bash 腳本，把資料夾裡所有 .log 檔壓縮起來，並解釋每一行。

請用繁體中文回答。
answer:
<invoke:Bash
<parameter name="command">cat > /tmp/tmp8hdey2je/compress_logs.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

dir="${1:-.}"

if [[ ! -d "$dir" ]]; then
  echo "錯誤：'$dir' 不是資料夾" >&2
  exit 1
fi

shopt -s nullglob
logs=("$dir"/*.log)
shopt -u nullglob

if (( ${#logs[@]} == 0 )); then
  echo "在 '$dir' 中找不到 .log 檔" >&2
  exit 1
fi

names=()
for f in "${logs[@]}"; do
  names+=("$(basename "$f")")
done

archive="logs_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz"

tar -czf "$dir/$archive" -C "$dir" "${names[@]}"

echo "已壓縮 ${#names[@]} 個檔案 -> $dir/$archive"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/tmp8hdey2je/compress_logs.sh
# test in scratchpad
T=/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-tmp8hdey2je/7dcced1b-269c-54f1-b09a-b30a9e544490/scratchpad/testlogs
rm -rf "$T"; mkdir -p "$T"; echo "a" > "$T/app.log"; echo "b" > "$T/err.log"; echo "x" > "$T/notes.txt"
/tmp/tmp8hdey2je/compress_logs.sh "$T"
tar -tzf "$T"/logs_*.tar.gz
bash /tmp/tmp8hdey2je/compress_logs.sh /nonexistent; echo "exit=$?"</parameter>
</invoke>
